title: rustle benchmark campaigns
description: Every published campaign, newest last. Each campaign is self-contained; numbers are not comparable across campaigns (the protocol, the versions and the hardware change). Hand-edited, checked against the campaign folders.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editors.

latest.description: Id of the campaign the website shows.

proxyId.title: Proxy id
proxyId.description: Identifier of a compared proxy. A new proxy is added here: an additive change.

id.title: Campaign id
id.description: Id of the campaign: its folder name under bench/data/ and bench/published/.

rustle_version.title: rustle version
rustle_version.description: Version of rustle that was benchmarked.

proxies.title: Proxies
proxies.description: The proxies compared in that campaign, in column order.
